main_text.l: cum de antiquo Hebræorum anno repu-
to: quem nescio — qui Catoblepæ non
re fuisse lunarem, vocariqve non semel יבח Mensem, &
addi mox חורש [?] ne non satis ἰσοφικῶς [?] exprimatur historia,
sedere cœpit apud me jampridem senten-
tia, nihil minus in illa gente solemne
fuisse, quam ut Pascha sequeretur æqui-
noctium, imo enim vero interdum te-
nuisse vel octiduum totum ante istum
garriunt, rideo: qui in sacris nihil invenio quam תקופת השנה ותשובת השנה tempestatis istas duas hinc de-clivis

page.notes: Page is clean and legible. Doubtful readings: the Hebrew word after "mox" (printed as חורש, perhaps חודש); the Greek word before "exprimatur" (ἰσοφικῶς, uncertain); the Greek word "τήρησιν" (accent may differ). The Hebrew word at the start of "Mensem" line is printed as יבח, possibly ירח. A small stray "s" stands at the end of the line "Same sol", after "sol"; it is not part of the text and is not transcribed. Printed "Same" is read as "Sane". The Hebrew line "השנה" stands at the left of the line "tempestatis istas duas hinc de-". Printing errors are left as printed.
